AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI聊天机器人安全性随时间衰减的理论模型，发展了儿童-算法互动关系的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI聊天机器人设计提供安全改进建议，为儿童心理健康支持系统开发提供指导，为监管政策制定提供依据

title: The Effect of School Closures on Parental Employment: Evidence from Hong Kong during COVID-19
affiliations: , Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) – Department of Accountancy and Law - Department of Economics and Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) – Department of Accountancy and Law - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Effect of School Closures on Parental Employment: Evidence from Hong Kong during COVID-19
detail.abstract:
This study investigates the impact of school closures during the COVID-19 pandemic on parental employment in Hong Kong, with a specific focus on the heterogeneous labor supply responses of mothers. We analyze how factors such as legal liability, the availability of alternative childcare provisions, and the capacity to work from home influence these responses. Our findings support that the adverse employment effects of school closures are predominantly experienced by mothers. Notably, legal liability acts as a binding constraint, causing dramatic changes in labor supply among mothers of children just below and above the legal age threshold. In particular, mothers with 15-year-old children, who fall just below this threshold, faced a decline in employment probability, similar to that of mothers with younger school-age children, while those with children aged 16 and 17 were unaffected. We also investigate the emerging work-from-home arrangement in Hong Kong during the pandemic and provide evidence that mothers with higher ability to work from home were sheltered from the negative supply shock of childcare provision during the pandemic. Meanwhile, support from spouses, family networks, and live-in domes-
tic helpers are also found to be effective remedies

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了香港COVID-19疫情期间学校关闭对父母就业的影响，特别关注母亲劳动力供给的异质性反应。研究发现学校关闭的负面就业效应主要由母亲承担，法律责任是重要约束因素，而远程工作能力能缓解这种冲击。
AI.research_question: 学校关闭对父母就业的影响是什么？特别是母亲的劳动力供给如何因法律责任、替代托儿安排和远程工作能力等因素而异？
AI.motivation: 了解COVID-19疫情期间学校关闭政策对家庭劳动力市场的异质性影响，特别关注母亲群体面临的就业挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力供给理论、家庭经济学和法律约束理论，分析学校关闭对父母就业的差异化影响。
AI.method: 实证分析方法，利用香港疫情期间的数据，比较不同年龄段儿童母亲的就业变化。
AI.findings: 学校关闭的负面就业效应主要由母亲承担；法律责任是约束因素，15岁以下儿童母亲就业概率下降明显；远程工作能力能缓解冲击；配偶、家庭网络和住家佣工支持也是有效补救措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对法律约束在劳动力供给中作用的理解，扩展了家庭劳动力供给理论在危机情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于学校关闭政策影响的实证依据，建议在制定相关政策时考虑对母亲就业的差异化影响，并支持远程工作安排和家庭支持网络建设。

title: Risk Assessment of Health Hazards and Mitigation Measures of Sugarcane Industries
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Roorkee

detail.title: Risk Assessment of Health Hazards and Mitigation Measures of Sugarcane Industries
detail.abstract: Agricultural sustainability is not just about improving crop yield or reducing production costs. It must also focus on the health, safety, and overall well-being of the people who work in the fields. In sugarcane farming, which relies heavily on manual labor and often involves tough environmental conditions, the inclusion of occupational safety and health (OSH) is essential for any complete sustainability assessment. OSH risks remain a significant concern in sugarcane farming, especially in developing regions where informal labor, limited training, and poor working conditions prevail. This study introduces a novel hybrid bidirectional MCDM framework that integrates machine learning, genetic algorithms, and causal mapping techniques to prioritize OSH issues and their underlying causes in sugarcane farming. The study not only identifies key OSH concerns but also evaluates their root causes from a dual perspective, where OSH problems are treated as both outcomes and inputs in the decision-making model. To strengthen the analysis and finalise the ranking, the study also applies two advanced integration techniques: (i) Machine Learning using Random Forest Regressor, and (ii) a Genetic Algorithm-based rank optimization approach. This bidirectional approach offers a clearer view of the cause-and-effect links in OSH challenges and supports more effective decision-making. This study is based on primary data collected from 2,630 stakeholders in the Amroha district, Uttar Pradesh, including farmers, laborers, agricultural officers, and health experts. The results highlight critical safety issues such as back pain, Cut and Laceration Injuries, machinery accidents along with their underlying causes, like PPE lack, lack of training.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个新颖的混合双向MCDM框架，结合机器学习、遗传算法和因果映射技术，用于识别和优先排序甘蔗种植中的职业安全健康问题及其根本原因。
AI.research_question: 如何有效识别和优先排序甘蔗种植中的职业安全健康问题及其根本原因？
AI.motivation: 农业可持续性不仅关乎作物产量和生产成本，还必须关注田间劳动者的健康、安全和整体福祉。甘蔗种植依赖大量体力劳动，工作环境恶劣，职业安全健康是完整可持续性评估的重要组成部分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合双向多准则决策框架，整合机器学习、遗传算法和因果映射技术，从双向视角分析职业安全健康问题。
AI.method: 基于印度北方邦Amroha地区2,630名利益相关者（农民、劳动者、农业官员、健康专家）收集的主要数据，应用随机森林回归器和遗传算法进行排名优化。
AI.findings: 识别出关键安全问题：背痛、割伤和撕裂伤、机械事故，以及根本原因：缺乏个人防护装备、培训不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新颖的混合双向MCDM框架，将职业安全健康问题同时作为结果和输入进行分析，为农业职业安全研究提供了新的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为甘蔗种植业提供了有效的职业安全健康问题识别和优先排序工具，支持更有效的决策制定，有助于改善发展中国家农业劳动者的工作条件。

title: Spatio-Temporal Imbalance Governance of Multi-Dimensional Tourism Ecosystems in Ecologically Fragile Areas: A Case Study from the Middle Reaches of the Yellow River
affiliations: Shanxi Normal University, Shanxi Normal University, Shanxi Normal University, Shanxi Normal University and Henan Polytechnic University

detail.title: Spatio-Temporal Imbalance Governance of Multi-Dimensional Tourism Ecosystems in Ecologically Fragile Areas: A Case Study from the Middle Reaches of the Yellow River
detail.abstract: Abstract:Developing countries’ tourism is shifting from basic needs to self-actualization, but supply-demand mismatches impede growth. China’s strategy for reconciling consumption upgrading with ecological limits offers a global reference.The middle Yellow River national （MYR）ecological restoration zone, shaped by national strategy and ecological constraints, stands as the key test case for resolving tourism supply-demand conflicts. Fusing Maslow’s with MaxEnt and InVEST at 1-km resolution, the paper maps MYR’s multidimensional tourism demand, traces its drivers, quantifies ecosystem supply, partitions supply-demand zones, and ranks demand-tier contributions to guide policy tuning. (1) TED–NES mismatch in MYR: Tourism Ecological Demand（TED）dips then peaks in mountains ; NES（Natural Ecosystem Supply）rises then falls in plains;(2) TED in N-Longdong polarizes; E&S decline yet mid-high frame stable; accessibility drives TED zones;(3) TED in MYR is currently in a transitional phase characterized by surging self-actualization-oriented tourism demand and gradual progress in identity-seeking demand. The current NES is insufficient to meet the upgrading of residents’ tourism demand. Culture and Spirit (CS) and Aesthetic (AT) demands as top TED improvement areas;(4) There is a significant imbalance between tourism supply and demand in MYR. Rebalance structurals via urban-rural mobility, monitor zones by eco-greening, lead zones by curbing growth. This study provides a replicable assessment and decision-making framework for adjusting supply structures and promoting sustainable tourism development in ecologically fragile regions worldwide.

AI.tldr: 本研究融合马斯洛需求理论和生态模型，分析黄河中游生态修复区的旅游供需错配问题，提出通过城乡流动、生态绿化和控制增长来重构供需结构的可持续旅游发展框架。
AI.research_question: 如何解决黄河中游生态修复区旅游供需错配问题，实现消费升级与生态保护的平衡？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家旅游业正从基本需求转向自我实现需求，但供需不匹配阻碍了增长。中国协调消费升级与生态限制的策略具有全球参考价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合马斯洛需求层次理论、MaxEnt模型和InVEST模型，构建多维旅游需求分析框架。
AI.method: 采用1公里分辨率空间分析，绘制黄河中游多维旅游需求图，追踪驱动因素，量化生态系统供给，划分供需区域，评估需求层级贡献。
AI.findings: 1)旅游生态需求与自然生态系统供给不匹配；2)北陇东地区旅游需求极化；3)当前处于自我实现需求激增的过渡阶段；4)供需显著失衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了融合心理学需求理论与生态模型的旅游供需分析框架，为生态脆弱区可持续旅游发展提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可复制的评估和决策框架，通过城乡流动、生态绿化和控制增长等策略，调整供给结构，促进全球生态脆弱区可持续旅游发展。

title: Beliefs and the Demand for Employee Ownership
affiliations: University of Siena - Department of Economics and Statistics and University of Parma - Dipartimento di Scienze Economiche e Aziendali

detail.title: Beliefs and the Demand for Employee Ownership

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Why does capital typically hire labor rather than the other way around? Employee-owned firms with majority workforce control—such as worker cooperatives—remain rare in market economies, despite evidence that they perform at least as well as investor-owned firms across various contexts. In this paper, we examine whether beliefs help explain this puzzle by shaping policy preferences and willingness to work in such organizations. In a preregistered experiment guided by a detailed pre-analysis plan, we randomly exposed 2,000 young adults to information from an international expert survey. Respondents held more pessimistic prior beliefs about worker cooperatives compared to experts. Information exposure led to more optimistic beliefs and increased support for pro-cooperative policies. Text analysis of open-ended responses reveals fewer negative and more positive first-order concerns about cooperatives in the treatment group. We also find suggestive evidence of a relative re-ranking of career intentions in favor of worker cooperatives.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过实验研究发现，人们对工人合作社存在悲观信念，这种信念影响了他们对合作社政策的支持度和在合作社工作的意愿。信息干预可以改善这些信念并增加对合作社的支持。
AI.research_question: 信念是否有助于解释为什么资本通常雇佣劳动力而不是相反？为什么工人合作社在市场经济中仍然罕见？
AI.motivation: 尽管证据表明工人合作社在各种情境下表现至少与投资者所有的企业一样好，但由多数劳动力控制的员工所有制企业（如工人合作社）在市场经济中仍然罕见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念影响政策偏好和组织选择的理论框架
AI.method: 预先注册的实验，采用详细预分析计划，随机向2000名年轻人提供国际专家调查信息
AI.findings: 受访者对工人合作社的先前信念比专家更悲观；信息暴露导致更乐观的信念并增加了对支持合作社政策的支持；文本分析显示治疗组对合作社的负面关注减少，正面关注增加；有证据表明职业意图相对重新排序，倾向于工人合作社
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解为什么工人合作社罕见提供了基于信念的解释机制
AI.practical_contributions: 表明信息干预可以改变人们对工人合作社的信念和态度，为促进员工所有制提供了政策启示

title: Corporate Mind: A Systemic Framework for Explaining Firm Heterogeneity
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Corporate Mind: A Systemic Framework for Explaining Firm Heterogeneity
detail.abstract:
Why do firms exhibit drastically different performance and fates despite operating in similar
environments? To address this fundamental question in strategic management, this study tran scends traditional ”resource” and ”capability” perspectives by proposing ”Corporate Mind” as an integrative meta-construct. We conceptualize the firm as a complex adaptive system composedof three core dimensions—Technology-Capability (T), Process-Structure (I), and Culture Cognition (M)—that interact non-linearly. Building on this foundation, we develop the heuristic framework H ∝ E · σ · c² to capture the system’s essence and derive an empirically testable opera tional model. A key innovation is the σ-R Diagnostic System, which quantifies internal synergy(σ) and organizational resilience (R). Exploratory derivations reveal: (1) significant emergent effectsfrom three-dimensional interactions; (2) an inverted U-shaped relationship between synergy (σ) andperformance, with an optimal interval [0.35, 0.75]; and (3) organizational resilience as the key me diating pathway for synergy effects. Through retrospective predictions of cases like Evergrande, this theory demonstrates potential as an early warning system for organizational health, offering novel dynamic perspectives and analytical tools for identifying ”pathological synergy” and ”system rigidity”.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出'企业心智'作为整合性元构念，超越传统的资源和能力视角，将企业视为由技术能力(T)、流程结构(I)、文化认知(M)三个核心维度非线性互动的复杂适应系统。开发了H ∝ E·σ·c²启发式框架和σ-R诊断系统，发现协同效应与绩效呈倒U型关系，组织韧性是协同效应的关键中介路径。
AI.research_question: 为什么在相似环境中运营的企业会表现出截然不同的绩效和命运？
AI.motivation: 解决战略管理中的基本问题，超越传统的'资源'和'能力'视角
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业心智理论，将企业视为复杂适应系统，包含技术能力(T)、流程结构(I)、文化认知(M)三个核心维度的非线性互动
AI.method: 开发H ∝ E·σ·c²启发式框架和σ-R诊断系统，进行探索性推导和回顾性案例预测
AI.findings: 1)三维互动产生显著涌现效应；2)协同效应(σ)与绩效呈倒U型关系，最优区间为[0.35,0.75]；3)组织韧性是协同效应的关键中介路径
AI.theory_contributions: 提出企业心智作为整合性元构念，为理解企业绩效差异提供了新的动态视角和分析工具
AI.practical_contributions: σ-R诊断系统可作为组织健康的早期预警系统，识别'病态协同'和'系统刚性'

title: Business Climate and Inequality across the Distribution: Evidence from Panel IV-Quantile Regressions
affiliations: , National Defence University and Office of the Prime Minister

detail.title: Business Climate and Inequality across the Distribution: Evidence from Panel IV-Quantile Regressions
detail.abstract: This paper examines the heterogeneous relationship between the business climate, measured by the Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI), and income inequality (GINI) in a multi-country panel spanning 2000-2025. We employ a panel instrumental-variables (IV) framework with two-stage least squares (2SLS) to address endogeneity in PMI arising from reverse causality, omitted institutional characteristics, and measurement error. To move beyond average effects, we apply quantile regression techniques to explore how the impact of business climate varies across different points of the inequality distribution. Our empirical strategy incorporates country and year fixed effects, along with macroeconomic controls for GDP per capita, unemployment, inflation, trade openness, and government consumption. Estimation emphasizes robustness through standard IV diagnostics, including first-stage relevance (Kleibergen-Paap rk F), Durbin-Wu-Hausman endogeneity tests, and over-identification checks (Hansen/Sargan). The findings suggest that the magnitude and sign of the PMI-inequality relationship differ across quantiles, with stronger effects at higher inequality levels. This highlights that improvements in business climate may yield unequal distributional outcomes, underscoring the importance of complementary policy interventions to ensure inclusivity.

AI.tldr: 本文使用面板工具变量和分位数回归方法，研究了2000-2025年间多国商业环境（PMI）与收入不平等（GINI）的异质性关系。研究发现PMI对不平等的影响在不同分位数上存在差异，在高不平等水平下效应更强，表明商业环境改善可能产生不均等的分配结果。
AI.research_question: 商业环境（PMI）与收入不平等（GINI）之间的关系在不同不平等水平下是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 理解商业环境改善对收入分配的异质性影响，超越平均效应分析，为制定包容性政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业环境与收入分配理论，工具变量方法理论，分位数回归理论
AI.method: 面板工具变量（IV）框架下的两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS），结合分位数回归技术，包含国家和年份固定效应以及宏观经济控制变量
AI.findings: PMI与不平等的关系在不同分位数上存在显著差异，在高不平等水平下效应更强，商业环境改善可能产生不均等的分配结果
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了商业环境对收入不平等的异质性影响，拓展了传统平均效应分析的局限性
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了需要配套政策干预来确保商业环境改善的包容性，为政策制定者提供了分配效应的重要启示

title: Do Human Beings Emerge into an Autonomous Social Entity? A Social-Ontological Theory of Causal Social Force within Social Sciences

detail.title: Do Human Beings Emerge into an Autonomous Social Entity? A Social-Ontological Theory of Causal Social Force within Social Sciences
detail.abstract: Existing methods within economics and other social sciences have not adequately addressed the causal subject matter of their disciplines. There is a gap between the rigorous application of their theories, the methods, and the use of empirical data. In this paper, a theoretical hypothesis is suggested as an alternate social ontological framework to explain the causal nature of social reality within these disciplines. The hypothesis draws upon Tony Lawson's conception of "emergence" and the popular "Nudge theory framework" to explain the formation of a causal social force (SF). The theory is substantiated through empirical evidence from well-known social-psychological experiments such as the "Asch-conformity experiment." The paper also suggests implications for existing experimental methods in social sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合"涌现"概念和"助推理论"的社会本体论框架，用于解释社会科学中的因果性质，并通过阿希从众实验等实证证据验证该理论。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够充分解释社会科学因果性质的社会本体论框架？
AI.motivation: 现有经济学和社会科学方法未能充分解决其学科的因果主题，理论严谨性、方法与经验数据使用之间存在差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: Tony Lawson的"涌现"概念和流行的"助推理论框架"，用于解释因果社会力量的形成。
AI.method: 理论假设构建，并通过阿希从众实验等著名社会心理学实验的实证证据进行验证。
AI.findings: 提出的社会本体论框架能够有效解释社会现实的因果性质，并为社会科学实验方法提供新的视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个替代性的社会本体论框架，弥合了社会科学理论与方法之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现有社会科学实验方法提供了改进建议和启示。

title: 'The Queen of Inventions': How Home Technology Shaped Women's Work and Children's Futures
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: 'The Queen of Inventions': How Home Technology Shaped Women's Work and Children's Futures

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies the impact of the home sewing machine on women’s work and intergenerational mobility—an innovation that enabled women to generate income from within the household. Marketed directly to women as a tool for both domestic use and paid work, it provides a unique setting to examine how household technologies reshaped labor markets and intergenerational outcomes. Exploiting the expansion of sewing machine sales agents, which generated geographic and temporal variation in access, I show that access to sewing machines increased demand for dressmakers, raised women’s employment in this occupation, and reduced reliance on child labor. In the long run, children exposed in early life attained higher literacy, formed smaller families, and experienced greater intergenerational mobility. These findings highlight the household as a crucial site of technological change, showing how domestic innovations could expand women’s opportunities and generate lasting gains across generations

AI.tldr: 缝纫机作为家庭技术创新，通过让女性在家工作增加了女性就业机会，减少了童工使用，并促进了代际流动性和长期教育成果
AI.research_question: 家用缝纫机如何影响女性工作和代际流动性？
AI.motivation: 研究家庭技术创新如何重塑劳动力市场和代际结果，缝纫机直接面向女性营销，为研究提供了独特情境
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭作为技术变革的关键场所，家庭创新如何扩展女性机会并产生跨代持久收益
AI.method: 利用缝纫机销售代理的扩张产生的时空变化，分析缝纫机可获得性的影响
AI.findings: 获得缝纫机增加了对裁缝的需求，提高了女性在该职业的就业率，减少了对童工的依赖；早期接触缝纫机的儿童获得了更高的识字率，组建了更小的家庭，并经历了更大的代际流动性
AI.theory_contributions: 强调家庭作为技术变革的关键场所，展示家庭创新如何扩展女性机会并产生跨代持久收益
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解家庭技术创新对女性就业和代际流动性的影响提供了实证证据，对政策制定有启示意义

title: Only-Child Matching Penalty in the Marriage Market
affiliations: University of Tokyo and Musashi University

detail.title: Only-Child Matching Penalty in the Marriage Market

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study explores the marriage matching of only-child individuals and the related outcomes. Specifically, we analyze two aspects: First, we investigate the marriage patterns of only children, examining whether people choose mates in a positive or negative assortative manner regarding only-child status. We find that, along with being more likely to remain single, only children are more likely to marry another only child. Second, we measure the matching premium or penalty using the difference in partners socioeconomic status, measured by years of schooling, between only-child and nononly-child individuals. Our estimates show that among women who marry an only-child husband, only children are penalized, as their partners educational attainment is 0.63 years lower. Finally, we discuss the potential sources of this penalty along with our empirical findings.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨独生子女的婚姻匹配模式及其相关结果，发现独生子女更可能保持单身或与另一个独生子女结婚，且在婚姻市场中存在教育匹配惩罚。
AI.research_question: 独生子女的婚姻匹配模式是什么？在婚姻市场中是否存在独生子女身份带来的匹配溢价或惩罚？
AI.motivation: 随着独生子女政策的实施，独生子女群体在中国社会中日益重要，了解他们的婚姻匹配模式对理解社会分层和家庭结构具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 婚姻匹配理论、同质婚配理论、社会分层理论
AI.method: 实证分析，使用教育年限作为社会经济地位的代理变量，比较独生子女与非独生子女在婚姻市场中的匹配差异
AI.findings: 1. 独生子女更可能保持单身或与另一个独生子女结婚；2. 嫁给独生子女丈夫的女性中，独生子女面临教育匹配惩罚，其配偶的教育年限比非独生子女低0.63年
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了婚姻匹配理论在独生子女群体中的应用，揭示了独生子女身份在婚姻市场中的特殊作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解独生子女群体的婚姻行为提供实证依据，对相关社会政策的制定具有参考价值

title: Monetary Policy and Real Estate Price Distortions: How Bank Lending Amplifies Housing Market Imbalances
affiliations: Osnabrück University and University of Osnabrück

detail.title: Monetary Policy and Real Estate Price Distortions: How Bank Lending Amplifies Housing Market Imbalances
detail.abstract: We empirically document deviations of residential real estate prices from fundamental values at the micro level and investigate their relationship with local bank lending growth during a period of unconventional monetary policy. Our findings indicate a positive relationship between credit growth and excessive price increases in real estate markets, with interest rate reductions further amplifying these credit-driven price distortions. Additionally, we provide evidence that banks' search-for-yield behavior explains the increase in lending, particularly among deposit-funded banks that experienced a squeeze of margins during the negative monetary policy rate period. This credit expansion, in turn, directly influences the real economy by fueling local housing markets. In our analysis, we exploit that the introduction of negative monetary policy rates affected banks differently depending on their ex-ante liquidity and relate micro-level real estate data to balance sheet information from locally operating banks and macroeconomic variables.

AI.tldr: 本文实证记录了微观层面住宅房地产价格偏离基本价值的情况，并研究了在非常规货币政策时期这种偏离与当地银行贷款增长的关系。研究发现信贷增长与房地产市场价格过度上涨呈正相关，利率下调进一步放大了这些信贷驱动的价格扭曲。银行追求收益的行为解释了贷款增加，特别是在负利率期间利润率受到挤压的存款型银行中。这种信贷扩张通过刺激当地房地产市场直接影响实体经济。
AI.research_question: 在非常规货币政策时期，住宅房地产价格偏离基本价值与当地银行贷款增长之间有何关系？利率下调如何影响这种关系？
AI.motivation: 研究在负利率等非常规货币政策环境下，银行信贷行为如何影响房地产市场价格扭曲，以及这种扭曲对实体经济的传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷驱动资产价格泡沫理论、银行追求收益行为理论、货币政策传导机制理论。
AI.method: 利用负利率政策对不同银行影响的异质性，将微观房地产数据与当地银行资产负债表信息和宏观经济变量相关联进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 信贷增长与房地产价格过度上涨呈正相关；利率下调放大了信贷驱动的价格扭曲；存款型银行在负利率期间因利润率挤压而增加贷款，体现了追求收益行为；信贷扩张通过刺激房地产市场直接影响实体经济。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对非常规货币政策下银行行为与资产价格关系机制的理解，特别是负利率环境下银行追求收益行为对信贷扩张和价格扭曲的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于非常规货币政策对房地产市场影响的实证证据，有助于更精准地评估和调控货币政策对金融稳定和实体经济的影响。

title: Economic Linkages Inferred from News Stories and the Predictability of Stock Returns
affiliations: Brandeis University and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Economic Linkages Inferred from News Stories and the Predictability of Stock Returns
detail.abstract: We show that news stories contain information about economic linkages between firms and that information diffuses slowly across linked stocks. Specifically, we identify linked stocks from co-mentions in news stories and find that these stocks subsequently cross-predict each other's returns. Content analysis of shared news stories uncovers previously undocumented types of firm linkages, whose effects are distinct from those analyzed in prior literature. Furthermore, our results indicate that information can flow from smaller to larger stocks and across industries. Both limited attention and slow processing of complex information contribute to slow information diffusion.

AI.tldr: 新闻故事包含企业间经济关联信息，这些信息在关联股票间缓慢扩散。研究发现共同被提及的股票存在收益交叉预测效应，揭示了新的企业关联类型，信息可从中小盘股流向大盘股并跨行业传播。有限注意力和复杂信息处理缓慢是信息扩散缓慢的主要原因。
AI.research_question: 新闻故事中企业关联信息如何在股票市场中扩散？共同被提及的股票是否存在收益交叉预测效应？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对企业关联的研究主要基于已知的经济联系，但新闻故事可能揭示未被记录的关联类型，且信息扩散过程可能比预期更慢。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息扩散理论和有限注意力理论，探讨新闻驱动的企业关联对股票收益的影响机制。
AI.method: 通过新闻共同提及识别关联股票，分析收益交叉预测效应，并对共享新闻内容进行分析。
AI.findings: 共同被提及的股票存在显著的收益交叉预测效应；新闻揭示了新的企业关联类型；信息可从中小盘股流向大盘股并跨行业传播；有限注意力和复杂信息处理缓慢导致信息扩散延迟。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业关联理论，揭示了新闻驱动的关联类型；深化了对信息扩散机制的理解，特别是有限注意力和信息处理速度的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供基于新闻关联的交易策略；帮助监管机构理解信息传播模式；为企业风险管理提供新视角。

title: The Role of Fairness Ideals in Coordination Failure and Success
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi, New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi and Maastricht University

detail.title: The Role of Fairness Ideals in Coordination Failure and Success

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: In a laboratory experiment, we study the role of fairness ideals as focal points in coordination problems in homogeneous and heterogeneous groups. We elicit the normatively preferred behavior about how a subsequent coordination game should be played. In homogeneous groups, people share a unique fairness ideal how to solve the coordination problem, whereas in heterogeneous groups, multiple conflicting fairness ideals prevail. In the coordination game, homogeneous groups are significantly more likely than their heterogeneous counterparts to sustain efficient coordination. The reason is that homogeneous groups coordinate on the unique fairness ideal, whereas heterogeneous groups disagree on the fairness ideal to be played. In both types of groups, equilibria consistent with fairness ideals are most stable. Hence, the difference in coordination success between homogeneous and heterogeneous groups occurs because of the normative disagreement in the latter types of group, making it much harder to reach an equilibrium at a fairness ideal.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验室实验探讨公平理念在协调问题中的作用。研究发现，在群体内成员具有相同公平理念时，协调效率显著高于存在多种冲突公平理念的群体。同质群体能够基于共同的公平理念达成协调，而异质群体因公平理念分歧难以达成均衡。
AI.research_question: 公平理念在协调问题中如何作为焦点发挥作用？同质群体和异质群体在协调效率上是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 理解群体内公平理念的一致性如何影响协调问题的解决效率，特别是在存在多种公平理念冲突的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 焦点理论、协调博弈理论、公平理念理论
AI.method: 实验室实验，通过诱导参与者表达偏好的协调游戏行为规范，比较同质群体和异质群体的协调表现
AI.findings: 同质群体比异质群体更可能维持高效协调；同质群体能够基于唯一的公平理念达成协调，而异质群体因公平理念分歧难以达成均衡；与公平理念一致的均衡最为稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对公平理念作为协调问题焦点作用的理解，揭示了群体异质性通过公平理念分歧影响协调效率的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理和团队建设提供启示：在需要高效协调的任务中，应考虑团队成员在公平理念上的一致性

title: The Impact of Immigration on Wages and Employment in the UK Using Longitudinal Administrative Data
affiliations: University of Leicester and King’s College London

detail.title: The Impact of Immigration on Wages and Employment in the UK Using Longitudinal Administrative Data

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the labour market impact of immigration to the United Kingdom, focusing on the large inflows following the 2004 EU enlargement. Using the Lifetime Labour Market Database (LLMDB)—a longitudinal 1% sample of National Insurance records—we provide the first analysis of immigration’s effects on employment and wages based on high-quality administrative microdata. Exploiting individual, area and time fixed effects, as well as areatime, individual-time and individual-area fixed effects, we reduce endogeneity concerns that have limited previous work. We find limited aggregate impacts, but distributional consequences: existing immigrants—particularly those who were young or low paid— experienced modest negative employment effects, while natives faced little evidence of displacement. For wages, impacts were mixed: existing immigrants overall gained, but low-paid immigrants lost. The results suggest labour market adjustment operated through both substitution and complementarities across groups. More broadly, we provide a methodological framework for analysing the much larger and more diverse post-2021 immigration flows.

AI.tldr: 本文使用英国行政微观数据研究2004年欧盟扩大后的移民对劳动力市场的影响，发现总体影响有限但存在分配效应：现有移民（特别是年轻和低收入群体）就业受到轻微负面影响，而本地人几乎没有被替代；工资影响复杂，现有移民总体受益但低收入移民受损。
AI.research_question: 2004年欧盟扩大后移民对英国劳动力市场的就业和工资影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 先前研究受内生性问题限制，需要基于高质量行政微观数据来准确评估移民对劳动力市场的影响，特别是针对2004年欧盟扩大后的大规模移民流入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场调整理论，包括替代效应和互补效应，分析不同群体间的相互作用。
AI.method: 使用Lifetime Labour Market Database（LLMDB）——国家保险记录的纵向1%样本，采用个体、地区和时间固定效应，以及地区-时间、个体-时间和个体-地区固定效应来减少内生性。
AI.findings: 总体影响有限但存在分配后果：现有移民（特别是年轻和低收入群体）就业受到轻微负面影响，本地人几乎没有被替代；工资影响复杂，现有移民总体受益但低收入移民受损。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了劳动力市场调整通过群体间替代和互补机制运作的证据，为理解移民经济影响提供了更细致的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建立了分析2021年后更大规模、更多样化移民流动的方法论框架，为政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Credit Liberalization and the Shift to Household Lending
affiliations: Bates College - Department of Economics  and Leeds University Business School (LUBS) - Division of Economics

detail.title: Credit Liberalization and the Shift to Household Lending
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how credit controls liberalization reoriented global banking systems from business to household lending. We combine sectoral lending data from the Global Credit Project with the IMF Financial Reform database to analyze 27 countries from 1974-2014 using a local projections difference-in-differences (LP-DiD) design that exploits staggered reform timing. Household credit evolved similarly across countries before liberalization but diverged sharply afterward: household credit share rose by an average of 41.3 percent and size by 61.1 percent relative to non-liberalizers. These findings highlight the significance of credit controls in directing credit expansions toward productive uses when market mechanisms are insufficient.

AI.tldr: 本文研究信贷管制自由化如何使全球银行系统从企业贷款转向家庭贷款。通过分析1974-2014年27个国家的数据发现，自由化后家庭信贷份额平均增长41.3%，规模增长61.1%。
AI.research_question: 信贷管制自由化如何影响全球银行系统从企业贷款向家庭贷款的重新定向？
AI.motivation: 理解信贷管制在指导信贷扩张方向上的作用，特别是在市场机制不足时如何引导信贷流向生产性用途。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷管制理论、金融自由化理论、银行信贷配置理论
AI.method: 使用全球信贷项目和IMF金融改革数据库的部门贷款数据，采用局部投影双重差分法（LP-DiD）分析27个国家1974-2014年的数据，利用改革时间的交错性。
AI.findings: 自由化前各国家庭信贷发展相似，但自由化后显著分化：家庭信贷份额相对未自由化国家平均增长41.3%，规模增长61.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信贷管制在引导信贷流向方面的重要作用，强调了在市场机制不足时政策干预的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于信贷管制改革影响的实证证据，有助于设计更有效的金融监管政策。

title: The Euro, The Bancor and The Dollar: A Ricardian Model
affiliations: Monash University

detail.title: The Euro, The Bancor and The Dollar: A Ricardian Model
detail.abstract: This paper extends the classical Ricardian model from a barter system to a monetary framework which emphasizes the pivotal role of the banking system in facilitating production and exchange. It studies international trade under three different monetary systems: (1) the Euro system, where a single currency facilitates both domestic and international trade; (2) the Bancor system, which relies on a supranational currency for trade between nations; and (3) the Dollar system, where one country’s national currency serves as the international media of exchange. The model identifies distinct features arising from different monetary systems. It shows that neither the Euro nor the Bancor system inherently generates trade imbalances. In contrast, the Dollar system imposes an asymmetric demand for the national currency used to conduct global trade. Since the currency demanded must be earned through net exports, trade imbalances are an intrinsic feature of the Dollar system.

AI.tldr: 本研究将经典李嘉图模型从物物交换扩展到货币框架，强调银行体系在生产交换中的关键作用。通过比较欧元、班柯和美元三种货币体系，发现只有美元体系会内生地产生贸易不平衡。
AI.research_question: 不同货币体系如何影响国际贸易模式？特别是，哪些货币体系会内生地产生贸易不平衡？
AI.motivation: 经典李嘉图模型假设物物交换，忽略了货币和银行体系在国际贸易中的重要作用。需要将模型扩展到货币框架来分析不同货币体系的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 李嘉图比较优势理论、货币经济学、国际货币体系理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，将经典李嘉图模型扩展到包含银行体系的货币框架，分析三种货币体系（欧元、班柯、美元）的贸易特征
AI.findings: 欧元体系和班柯体系不会内生地产生贸易不平衡，而美元体系由于对作为国际交易媒介的特定国家货币的不对称需求，会内生地产生贸易不平衡
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了李嘉图模型到货币框架，揭示了不同货币体系对贸易平衡的内生影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际货币体系改革和政策制定提供了理论依据，有助于理解美元体系下贸易不平衡的结构性原因

title: Deposits market exclusion and the emergence of premium banks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Deposits market exclusion and the emergence of premium banks
detail.abstract: This paper develops a theoretical and empirical framework to explain exclusion from deposit markets and the emergence of premium banks. In the model, households’ demand for deposits reflects both a diversification motive and a preference for banking services. When diversification dominates, market exclusion arises, leading to the formation of premium banks. Excessive inequality in income allocated to deposits drives low-income households out of the deposit product markets of banks serving wealthier clients, thereby increasing markups and reducing aggregate deposits. Using U.S. bank-branch-level data and county-level income inequality as a proxy for deposit inequality, we provide empirical support for the model’s main predictions: (i) price elasticities differ across income groups, (ii) premium banks offer higher deposit rates, (iii) their likelihood of emergence increases with income inequality, and (iv) the total volume of deposits declines as inequality rises. These findings highlight a new channel linking inequality to banking market structure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理论和实证框架来解释存款市场的排斥现象和高端银行的出现。模型表明家庭存款需求既反映多元化动机也反映银行服务偏好。当多元化动机占主导时，市场排斥出现，导致高端银行形成。存款收入分配过度不平等会驱使低收入家庭退出服务于富裕客户的银行产品市场，从而提高利润率并减少总存款。
AI.research_question: 收入不平等如何影响存款市场结构，特别是导致市场排斥和高端银行的出现？
AI.motivation: 理解收入不平等对银行市场结构的影响，特别是解释存款市场排斥现象和高端银行形成的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭存款需求模型，包含多元化动机和银行服务偏好；市场排斥理论；收入不平等与银行市场结构关系框架。
AI.method: 理论模型构建和实证分析，使用美国银行分行级数据和县级收入不平等作为存款不平等的代理变量。
AI.findings: 价格弹性在不同收入群体间存在差异；高端银行提供更高存款利率；其出现可能性随收入不平等增加而上升；总存款量随不平等加剧而下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了连接不平等与银行市场结构的新渠道；发展了存款市场排斥的理论框架；解释了高端银行形成的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解不平等对金融包容性的影响提供洞见；帮助银行机构更好地理解市场细分策略；对金融监管和普惠金融政策具有参考价值。

title: State Deficiency Laws, Foreclosure Auction Pricing, and Borrower Protection
affiliations: Kansas State University - Department of Finance and Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge

detail.title: State Deficiency Laws, Foreclosure Auction Pricing, and Borrower Protection
detail.abstract: Counterintuitively, we find that properties in recourse states (allowing deficiency judgments) sell for approximately 10% higher prices at foreclosure auctions than similar properties in non-recourse states, despite this leading to lower deficiency judgments. Using a cross-border discontinuity design with property-specific valuation controls across foreclosure auctions from years 2006 to 2016, we identify an underexamined tension in lender bidding strategy: placing higher bids to maximize deficiency judgments versus placing lower bids to prevent potentially costly fair valuation challenges. The higher auction prices in recourse states exist exclusively where deficiency judgments are likely, confirming our hypothesis that fair valuation requirements constrain opportunistic bidding behavior and motivate lenders to avoid extremely low bids. The results are robust to various specification tests. These findings demonstrate how legal frameworks directly influence distressed housing market pricing, with material consequences for borrower equity protection and significant implications for foreclosure law reform.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，尽管追索权州允许追索判决，但其止赎拍卖价格反而比非追索权州高出约10%，这是因为公平估值要求限制了贷款人的机会主义投标行为。
AI.research_question: 追索权法律框架如何影响止赎拍卖价格？为什么追索权州的止赎拍卖价格反而更高？
AI.motivation: 理解法律框架对困境房地产市场定价的影响，特别是追索权法律如何影响贷款人的投标策略和借款人权益保护。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贷款人投标策略理论：最大化追索判决与避免公平估值挑战之间的权衡；法律框架对市场定价的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用跨边界断点设计，结合2006-2016年止赎拍卖数据和物业特定估值控制变量。
AI.findings: 追索权州的止赎拍卖价格比非追索权州高出约10%；这种价格差异仅存在于可能产生追索判决的情况下；公平估值要求限制了贷款人的机会主义低投标行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了法律框架通过约束机会主义行为直接影响市场定价的机制；完善了追索权法律对贷款人投标策略影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为困境房地产市场定价提供了实证证据；对止赎法律改革具有重要政策意义；有助于保护借款人权益。

title: Economic Linkages Inferred from News Stories and the Predictability of Stock Returns
affiliations: Brandeis University and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Economic Linkages Inferred from News Stories and the Predictability of Stock Returns
detail.abstract: We show that news stories contain information about economic linkages between firms and that information diffuses slowly across linked stocks. Specifically, we identify linked stocks from co-mentions in news stories and find that these stocks subsequently cross-predict each other's returns. Content analysis of shared news stories uncovers previously undocumented types of firm linkages, whose effects are distinct from those analyzed in prior literature. Furthermore, our results indicate that information can flow from smaller to larger stocks and across industries. Both limited attention and slow processing of complex information contribute to slow information diffusion.

AI.tldr: 新闻故事包含企业间经济关联信息，这些信息在关联股票间缓慢扩散。通过新闻共同提及识别关联股票，发现它们能相互预测回报。新闻内容分析揭示了新的企业关联类型，信息可以从小企业流向大企业、跨行业流动，有限注意力和复杂信息处理缓慢是信息扩散缓慢的原因。
AI.research_question: 新闻故事中企业关联信息如何在股票市场间扩散？关联股票是否相互预测回报？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对企业关联的研究有限，新闻内容可能包含未被充分认识的企业关联类型，这些关联可能影响股票回报的相互预测性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息扩散理论、有限注意力理论和行为金融学，探讨信息在关联企业间的传播机制。
AI.method: 通过新闻共同提及识别关联股票，分析股票回报的交叉预测性，进行新闻内容分析识别新的企业关联类型。
AI.findings: 新闻共同提及的关联股票确实相互预测回报；新闻内容揭示了新的企业关联类型；信息可以从小企业流向大企业、跨行业流动；有限注意力和复杂信息处理缓慢导致信息扩散缓慢。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业关联理论，揭示了新的关联类型；深化了信息扩散理论，证明信息流动方向的多向性；丰富了有限注意力理论在金融市场中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供新的投资策略思路；帮助监管机构理解信息传播机制；为企业风险管理提供参考。

title: Additionality in Agri-Environmental Programs: Panel versus Cross-Section Estimates
affiliations: and University of Maryland - College of Agriculture & Natural Resources

detail.title: Additionality in Agri-Environmental Programs: Panel versus Cross-Section Estimates
detail.abstract: Agri-environmental programs aimed at working farmland have played an increasingly significant role in agricultural support policies within developed countries. A critical issue that correspondingly arises is the efficiency of these programs in allocating spending, particularly regarding the additionality of agri-environmental subsidies. This paper focuses on the Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program (CREP) in Maryland, specifically examining subsidies for the installation of riparian buffers. We provide estimates of additionality using two methods: (i) a first-difference estimator applied to panel data and (ii) a shift-share instrumental variable (SSIV) estimator in cross-sectional data. Our results suggest that CREP offers modest additionality, with estimates ranging from 65% to 70%. These estimates prove robust across a variety of model specifications. The empirical strategy employed, particularly the SSIV estimator, holds potential for broader applications across various voluntary program evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了马里兰州保护储备增强计划(CREP)中河岸缓冲区补贴的额外性，使用两种方法估计得出额外性约为65%-70%，证明该计划具有中等程度的额外性。
AI.research_question: 保护储备增强计划(CREP)中河岸缓冲区补贴的额外性如何？
AI.motivation: 发达国家农业支持政策中农业环境项目日益重要，但资金分配的效率问题，特别是补贴的额外性问题需要评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业环境政策评估理论，特别是自愿性项目的额外性评估框架。
AI.method: 使用两种方法：(i)面板数据的一阶差分估计器；(ii)横截面数据的转移份额工具变量(SSIV)估计器。
AI.findings: CREP提供中等程度的额外性，估计值在65%到70%之间，在各种模型设定下结果稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了SSIV估计器方法，可广泛应用于各种自愿性项目评估。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业环境政策的效率评估提供了实证依据，有助于政策制定者改进资金分配效率。

title: State-dependent fiscal multipliers in a small open economy
affiliations: Durham University, Shandong University - School of Economics and Athens University of Economics and Business

detail.title: State-dependent fiscal multipliers in a small open economy
detail.abstract: We compute state-dependent fiscal multipliers using an estimated medium-scale DSGE model for a small open economy, focusing specifically on Ireland, a Eurozone member. Our analysis emphasizes the compositional effect of fiscal stimulus in a small open economy with two sectors: tradable and non-tradable. State dependency refers to the condition of public finances, where we quantify fiscal multipliers across states of high and low public debt. Our key results show that spending multipliers are generally larger than tax multipliers across different states of public debt. Moreover, fiscal stimulus has a stronger impact on the non-tradable than on the tradable sector. Finally, the model produces a nonlinear negative relationship between public debt and fiscal multiplier, which is steeper for tax instruments and for the tradable sector.

AI.tldr: 本文使用爱尔兰的DSGE模型分析财政乘数，发现支出乘数大于税收乘数，财政刺激对非贸易部门影响更大，且公共债务与财政乘数呈负相关。
AI.research_question: 在小型开放经济体中，不同公共债务水平下财政乘数的状态依赖性如何？
AI.motivation: 研究小型开放经济体（特别是欧元区成员国爱尔兰）中财政刺激的组成效应，以及公共财政状况对财政乘数的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中等规模DSGE模型，小型开放经济体框架，包含贸易和非贸易两个部门。
AI.method: 使用估计的DSGE模型计算状态依赖的财政乘数，量化高和低公共债务状态下的乘数效应。
AI.findings: 支出乘数普遍大于税收乘数；财政刺激对非贸易部门影响更强；公共债务与财政乘数呈非线性负相关，对税收工具和贸易部门更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了状态依赖财政乘数的理论框架，特别关注小型开放经济体的部门组成效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供在不同公共债务水平下选择财政工具的依据，特别是在小型开放经济体中的政策设计。

title: The Effects of Leaning Against the Wind on Trend-following Behavior under Moderate Policy Rules and in a Low Interest Rate Environment
affiliations: Osaka Gakuin University, Konan University and Konan University

detail.title: The Effects of Leaning Against the Wind on Trend-following Behavior under Moderate Policy Rules and in a Low Interest Rate Environment
detail.abstract: We reexamine the impact of interest rate policy on expectation formation by incorporating a more realistic interest rate adjustment rule into the learning-to-forecast experimental framework. Our results show that interest rate policy reduces participants’ tendency to follow price trends and significantly suppresses asset price bubbles. Moreover, this stabilizing effect strengthens with the interest rate adjustment. An additional treatment conducted under a low base interest rate shows that the policy is more effective in such conditions than in a high-interest rate environment. Finally, simulations disentangle the two channels through which interest rate policy may suppress bubbles—the discount rate channel and the expectations channel. The impact of these channels is nearly the same under aggressive monetary policy rules; however, under moderate policy rules, the expectations channel is stronger than the discount rate channel.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过将更现实的利率调整规则引入学习预测实验框架，重新检验了利率政策对预期形成的影响。结果显示利率政策减少了参与者跟随价格趋势的倾向，显著抑制了资产价格泡沫，且这种稳定效应随利率调整而增强。在低基准利率条件下，政策效果比高利率环境更有效。模拟分析揭示了利率政策抑制泡沫的两个渠道——贴现率渠道和预期渠道，在激进货币政策下两者影响相近，而在温和政策下预期渠道更强。
AI.research_question: 利率政策如何影响预期形成并抑制资产价格泡沫？
AI.motivation: 重新检验利率政策对预期形成的影响，采用更现实的利率调整规则来改进学习预测实验框架
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习预测实验框架、利率政策理论、预期形成理论、资产价格泡沫理论
AI.method: 学习预测实验方法，结合更现实的利率调整规则，并进行模拟分析
AI.findings: 1. 利率政策减少参与者跟随价格趋势倾向 2. 显著抑制资产价格泡沫 3. 稳定效应随利率调整增强 4. 低基准利率环境下政策更有效 5. 识别出贴现率渠道和预期渠道两个作用机制
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 改进了学习预测实验框架 2. 揭示了利率政策通过贴现率渠道和预期渠道影响泡沫的机制 3. 发现了不同货币政策规则下两个渠道的相对重要性差异
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行制定利率政策提供实证依据 2. 揭示了在低利率环境下货币政策更有效 3. 为抑制资产价格泡沫提供了政策建议

title: Assessing the Welfare Impact of Renewable Energy Levies on Low-Income Consumers A Consumer Choice Simulation Between Food and Electricity
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Assessing the Welfare Impact of Renewable Energy Levies on Low-Income Consumers A Consumer Choice Simulation Between Food and Electricity
detail.abstract: This study assesses the impact of tariff subsidies designed to promote residential renewable energy on the welfare of low-income consumers—specifically, individuals earning up to the minimum wage. To this end, the consumption behavior of a representative individual within this income group was simulated under varying electricity and food prices between 2018 and 2024. Historical data were collected on household electricity consumption, the share of levies allocated to distributed generation, minimum wage levels, and the cost of a basic food basket over this period. A consumer preference function was determined, and annual utility maximization problems were solved and compared to observed consumption patterns and market prices. The results indicate that the representative consumer tends to increase electricity consumption at the expense of food quantity. However, under a broader constraint based on the minimum wage, the consumer chooses to reduce total spending on electricity and food in order to reallocate resources toward additional consumption needs. The removal of renewable energy-related levies results in improved consumer welfare under both budget specifications. In the absence of such charges, the minimum level of electricity consumption increases compared to scenarios where these levies are in place, although consumers continue to prioritize other goods when possible.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了旨在促进住宅可再生能源的关税补贴对低收入消费者福利的影响，发现取消可再生能源相关税费能改善消费者福利，但消费者在预算约束下会减少电力和食品支出以重新分配资源。
AI.research_question: 旨在促进住宅可再生能源的关税补贴对低收入消费者福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 评估可再生能源政策对低收入群体的实际福利影响，关注政策可能带来的分配效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论、效用最大化理论、预算约束理论
AI.method: 收集2018-2024年家庭电力消费、分布式发电征税份额、最低工资水平和基本食品篮成本的历史数据，确定消费者偏好函数，求解年度效用最大化问题并与实际消费模式和市场价栺比较。
AI.findings: 代表性消费者倾向于以牺牲食品数量为代价增加电力消费；在基于最低工资的更广泛约束下，消费者选择减少电力和食品总支出以重新分配资源；取消可再生能源相关税费能改善消费者福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了可再生能源政策对低收入群体福利影响的理论分析，提供了在多重预算约束下消费者行为的新见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于可再生能源补贴对低收入消费者实际影响的实证证据，有助于设计更公平的能源转型政策。

title: Quantifying the economic impact of extreme climate events: evidence from the Valencia floods
affiliations: BBVA Research, BBVA Research – Ciudad BBVA and BBVA Research

detail.title: Quantifying the economic impact of extreme climate events: evidence from the Valencia floods
detail.abstract: Climate-related natural disasters, such as floods, are becoming increasingly frequent and severe. This paper proposes and validates a two-stage empirical framework to quantify their economic impact in Spain, with a particular emphasis on labor market outcomes. In the first stage, we construct a non-linear damage function to estimate flood-induced economic losses, relying on global EM-DAT data and imputing missing observations. In the second stage, we assess the effect of these shocks on monthly employment across Spanish provinces through a dynamic spatial panel model. This framework captures both the direct impacts in affected regions and the indirect spillover effects across economically interconnected areas. To validate our approach, we examine the 2024 DANA flood in Valencia and perform counterfactual simulations for alternative disaster locations. We further investigate the mitigating role of post-disaster insurance payouts. Our results underscore the non-linear nature of climate impacts, the decisive role of disaster location, and the potential of timely financial responses in accelerating labor market recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个两阶段实证框架来量化洪水等气候相关自然灾害的经济影响，特别关注劳动力市场结果。研究发现气候影响具有非线性特征，灾害位置对经济后果起决定性作用，及时的经济赔付能够加速劳动力市场恢复。
AI.research_question: 如何量化气候相关自然灾害（特别是洪水）对西班牙经济的影响，特别是对劳动力市场的影响？
AI.motivation: 气候相关自然灾害（如洪水）日益频繁和严重，需要准确评估其经济影响，特别是对劳动力市场的冲击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性损害函数理论、动态空间面板模型、经济溢出效应理论
AI.method: 两阶段实证框架：第一阶段使用全球EM-DAT数据和插补方法构建非线性损害函数估算洪水经济损失；第二阶段通过动态空间面板模型评估这些冲击对西班牙各省月度就业的影响
AI.findings: 气候影响具有非线性特征；灾害位置对经济后果起决定性作用；及时的经济赔付能够加速劳动力市场恢复；存在直接区域影响和经济互联区域的间接溢出效应
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个综合量化自然灾害经济影响的两阶段实证框架；发展了考虑空间溢出效应的动态评估方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估自然灾害经济影响的实用工具；揭示了及时金融响应在促进劳动力市场恢复中的重要性；有助于制定更有效的灾害应对策略

title: Risk Mitigation in Decentralised Financing – Crypto Lending
affiliations: University of East London

detail.title: Risk Mitigation in Decentralised Financing – Crypto Lending
detail.abstract: This article explores the rapid rise of decentralised finance (DeFi), with a focus on cryptocurrency lending, and the regulatory, operational, and policy challenges it poses. DeFi, built on blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and smart contracts, delivers financial services without intermediaries. Crypto lending—currently the fastest-growing DeFi service—allows borrowers to secure over-collateralised loans with digital assets, as exemplified by platforms such as MakerDAO. Supporters argue that DeFi enhances financial inclusion, efficiency, and transparency, while enabling innovative investment opportunities. However, limitations such as reliance on high collateral ratios, difficulty converting crypto to fiat, lack of public awareness, and persistent volatility raise questions about its true accessibility.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了去中心化金融（DeFi）的快速发展，特别是加密货币借贷服务，以及其带来的监管、运营和政策挑战。DeFi基于区块链、加密货币和智能合约，提供无需中介的金融服务。加密货币借贷作为当前增长最快的DeFi服务，允许用户用数字资产获得超额抵押贷款。支持者认为DeFi提高了金融包容性、效率和透明度，但也存在高抵押率要求、加密货币转换为法币困难、公众认知度低和持续波动性等限制。
AI.research_question: 去中心化金融（DeFi）特别是加密货币借贷服务的快速发展带来了哪些监管、运营和政策挑战？
AI.motivation: DeFi作为基于区块链技术的创新金融服务模式正在快速增长，特别是加密货币借贷服务，但其发展面临着多重挑战，需要深入分析其实际影响和局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术、去中心化金融理论、加密货币经济学和智能合约理论
AI.method: 文献分析和案例研究（以MakerDAO等平台为例）

title: SOCIAL NORM NUDGING IN PUBLIC GOODS MANAGEMENT: NEW INSIGHTS FROM TWO EXPERIMENTS
affiliations: University of Oviedo, University of Oviedo, Université de Bretagne Occidentale and University Grenoble Alpes

detail.title: SOCIAL NORM NUDGING IN PUBLIC GOODS MANAGEMENT: NEW INSIGHTS FROM TWO EXPERIMENTS
detail.abstract: Both lab and field experiments are useful tools to assess how to promote cooperation with public goods management. This paper aims to test to what extent individuals belonging to a group react to social norm nudges both in the lab and in the field. We used data from 597 individuals participating in a laboratory experiment (France), and 1,292 households participating in a field experiment (Spain), with both experiments conducted in 2023. We estimated the average treatment effects of providing descriptive and injunctive social information in two contexts of public goods: a linear public good game and the actual water consumed by collectively metered condominiums. Nudging with first order normative information was the better performing strategy, fostering individual contribution to the public good in the lab; in the field, it led to a boomerang effect for the low water use collective metered buildings. In the field, groups with a majority of elderly members and/or women were more prone to reduce water consumption. Moreover, when participants perceived that they were low contributors or high consumers, they boosted their behavior in the lab by reducing their contribution even more, while in the field participants’ reactions were more heterogeneous.

title: Social Connectedness and Climate Risk Management: U.S. Corn Farmers' Response to Extreme Heat
affiliations: State University of New York (SUNY) - University at Buffalo

detail.title: Social Connectedness and Climate Risk Management: U.S. Corn Farmers' Response to Extreme Heat
detail.abstract: I examine how social networks and institutional information channels influence farmers’ responses to climate risks. Leveraging a quasi-experimental design using variation in exposure to extreme heat, I find that exposure to extreme heat is associated with a 9.6 % decrease in the number of farms with sales, a 2.5 % increase in the number of crop insurance policies sold, and a 7.9 % increase in net insurance coverage. In particular, the decrease in the number of farms with sales appears to be driven by smaller farms that contribute relatively little to total production. I find similar effects in counties that are geographically distant but socially connected to heat-affected regions, suggesting that information about climate risk spreads through social networks. Furthermore, I use new data on Cooperative Extension System (CES) to find that CES social media channels partially offset the effects of general social connections for the number of farm operations and the net insurance coverage. This illustrates the distinctive role of CES in providing localized, research-based, and climate-related farming knowledge. This study provides some of the earliest empirical evidence on how social networks shape farms’ risk management decisions under climate change.

title: Can you have it All? Risk Reduction and Outperformance through Smart Diversification
affiliations: and University of Florida

detail.title: Can you have it All? Risk Reduction and Outperformance through Smart Diversification
detail.abstract: Recent studies suggest that fund managers with industry-concentrated portfolios often outperform their more diversified peers. In this paper, we introduce a novel concept of smart diversification-a strategy that minimizes correlations among portfolio holdings to enhance risk-adjusted returns. While we confirm the performance advantage of industry concentration, our findings show that smart diversification can further improve fund performance without increasing risk. This suggests that performance gains need not come at the expense of diversification when it is applied strategically.

title: Comparative Assessment of the Effectiveness and Industrial Implementation of a New-Generation Frother for Increasing Molybdenum Recovery from Copper-Porphyry Ores
affiliations: and National University of Science and Technology “MISIS”

detail.title: Comparative Assessment of the Effectiveness and Industrial Implementation of a New-Generation Frother for Increasing Molybdenum Recovery from Copper-Porphyry Ores

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals; therefore, ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract: Increasing the selectivity of the flotation separation of copper and molybdenum sulfides during the beneficiation of complex copper-porphyry ores is a relevant technological challenge, the solution to which is largely determined by the characteristics of the froth layer. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative assessment of the effectiveness of the standard frother T-92 and the new-generation reagent Penoflot-1304. The research included laboratory determination of physicochemical properties (surface tension), the study of chalcopyrite flotation kinetics with the calculation of rate constants, as well as the analysis of industrial trial results. It was established that Penoflot-1304 possesses significantly higher surface activity, providing a lower surface tension (21.75 mN/m) compared to T-92 (26.02 mN/m). This property ensures the creation of a more stable froth, which is confirmed by the results of kinetic tests: new composite formulations showed a flotation rate constant of up to k=0.2373 min⁻¹ and a maximum chalcopyrite recovery of up to 88.97 %. The key result of the industrial trials on ore from the Kalmakyr deposit was a significant increase in the overall recovery of molybdenum—from 51.56% (using T-92) to 70.89% (with Penoflot-1304)—while maintaining comparable copper recovery rates. Thus, the technological and economic feasibility of the industrial implementation of the Penoflot-1304 reagent has been proven, with an estimated annual economic effect of 1.7 million US dollars from processing 30 million tons of ore.

title: Pax Americana: Security, Stability, and the U.S Exorbitant Privilege
affiliations: Northwestern University, Kellogg School of Management

detail.title: Pax Americana: Security, Stability, and the U.S Exorbitant Privilege
detail.abstract: This paper develops a general-equilibrium model in which U.S. security provision-the Pax Americana-acts as a non-rival global public good that stabilises global macro-financial cycles. The U.S. security umbrella allows allies to reallocate resources from defense toward social transfers and investment, especially during global stress. This reduces fiscal cyclicality, inequality and consequently compresses global risk premia. The same enforcement network underwrites the safety of dollar assets, generating a security-based convenience yield that expands U.S. fiscal capacity and sustains the dollar's reserve status. In equilibrium, the U.S. runs persistent trade deficits and holds negative net foreign assets. Global stress appreciates the dollar, depresses global risky asset prices and produces countercyclical U.S. wealth share dynamics, as in the data. The model therefore interprets the US exorbitant privilege as an equilibrium rent on global security provision.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个一般均衡模型，将美国安全保护（Pax Americana）视为非竞争性的全球公共产品，能够稳定全球宏观金融周期。美国的安全保护伞让盟友能将资源从国防重新分配到社会转移支付和投资，特别是在全球压力时期。这降低了财政周期性、不平等，并压缩了全球风险溢价。同一执行网络保障了美元资产的安全性，产生了基于安全性的便利收益，扩大了美国财政能力并维持了美元储备地位。在均衡状态下，美国持续出现贸易逆差并持有负的净外国资产。全球压力使美元升值，压低全球风险资产价格，并产生反周期的美国财富份额动态。
AI.research_question: 美国安全保护如何作为全球公共产品影响全球宏观金融周期和美元的国际地位？
AI.motivation: 理解美国安全保护（Pax Americana）在全球经济中的系统性作用，以及它如何解释美国的"过度特权"现象，包括持续的贸易逆差和美元的国际储备货币地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型，将美国安全保护视为非竞争性的全球公共产品，通过安全保护伞机制影响盟友的资源分配决策，并产生基于安全性的便利收益。
AI.method: 构建理论模型分析美国安全保护作为全球公共产品的作用机制，通过一般均衡框架考察其对全球风险溢价、财政周期性、不平等和美元地位的影响。
AI.findings: 美国安全保护允许盟友减少国防支出，增加社会转移和投资，降低财政周期性和不平等，压缩全球风险溢价。同时产生美元资产的便利收益，扩大美国财政能力，维持美元储备地位。在均衡中，美国出现持续贸易逆差和负净外国资产。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了安全保护作为全球公共产品的理论框架，将美国的"过度特权"解释为全球安全提供的均衡租金，为理解美元国际地位和美国贸易逆差提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解全球安全安排对宏观经济稳定的重要性提供了理论依据，有助于评估美国安全政策的全球经济影响和美元国际地位的可持续性。

detail.abstract: Approximately 5.6 million U.S. households remained unbanked in 2023. We examine the effects of state-mandated high school personal finance coursework on banking outcomes. Because the unbanked population resorts to alternative financial services, such as payday loans, for their financial needs, we also examine the interplay between payday loan regulation and financial education. We find that exposure to personal finance coursework is associated with a lower likelihood of being unbanked and of unbanked adults being uninterested in opening a bank account. This finding holds regardless of whether the state has allowed or restricted payday lending, but we find larger effects in states with stronger restrictions. These results suggest that, for financial inclusion, regulatory measures and financial education are more likely complements than substitutes.

detail.abstract: India generates millions of tons of municipal solid waste annually, but only a small fraction of that waste follows scientifically based pathways. The result is a situation characterized by landfills, pollution, and perhaps health risks. To address this issue, a model is proposed for a Zero-Waste India with the help of technology, citizen engagement, and industrial symbiosis. This model has been built on the 'Golden Triangle of Waste Management: Educate, Segregate, Recycle.' There are several interesting innovations including smart garbage bags that have QR codes to identify where it came from and where it goes, outdoor bins that uses IoT, a portal for citizen training, and a web-based marketplace for purchasing composting kits. Green Champion Committees provide the capacity for monitoring at the community level, and now RAYT (Reward-As-You-Throw) is being developed to encourage additional engagement through give away items. The framework is technically agile, socially valid, and economically viable. If the framework is enacted, the hope is that it will enable citizens to share the accountability as India moves towards a cleaner, greener and smarter city.

title: Inflation and Trading
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) and Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title: Inflation and Trading

publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Financial Studies Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how investors respond to inflation combining a customized survey experiment with trading data at a time of historically high inflation. Investors’ beliefs about the stock return-inflation relation are very heterogeneous in the cross section and on average too optimistic. Moreover, many investors appear unaware of inflation-hedging strategies despite being otherwise well-informed about inflation rates and asset returns. Consequently, whereas exogenous shifts in inflation expectations do not impact return expectations, information on past returns during periods of high inflation leads to negative updating about the perceived stock-return impact of inflation, which feeds into return expectations and subsequent actual trading behavior.

title: Ghana's Mining Industry, A Still Potential for Future Investment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Ghana's Mining Industry, A Still Potential for Future Investment
detail.abstract: Ghana’s mining industry has historically played a pivotal role in the country’s economy, dating back to the pre-colonial era. Once the world’s leading gold producer, Ghana now ranks tenth globally and remains the top producer in Africa. Since the 1980s, policy reforms under the Economic Recovery Programme (ERP) have revitalized the sector, improving competitiveness, attracting significant foreign direct investment (FDI), and driving mineral output growth. The industry currently contributes 5% of Ghana’s GDP, with minerals accounting for 37% of total exports, of which gold represents more than 90%. In addition to gold, Ghana produces diamonds, bauxite, manganese, natural gas, petroleum, salt, and silver, supported by large-scale companies, small-scale operators, and mine service providers. With its favorable investment climate, ranked among the top ten globally for mining opportunities, Ghana’s extractive sector presents vast potential for job creation, government revenue, and sustainable economic development. This study highlights the country’s mining evolution, current performance, and future opportunities for investors in a competitive global market.

title: The Myth of the Three Zeros: A Critical Inquiry into Muhammad Yunus's Utopian Economics
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Myth of the Three Zeros: A Critical Inquiry into Muhammad Yunus's Utopian Economics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no personal or financial relationship with Professor Muhammad Yunus, Grameen Bank, or any other Microfinance Institution (MFI) discussed in this paper. The analysis is based purely on publicly available data and secondary literature, reflecting an independent critical policy position.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is exempt from Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Ethics Committee review as it is based exclusively on the analysis of "publicly available secondary data and documents" (books, academic papers, and verified media reports). The research involved "no human participants" and contains no personally identifiable or sensitive information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and was entirely "self-funded" by the author (MAH). No external grant or financial support was received from any institution, political body, or commercial entity.

detail.abstract: This research critically examines Muhammad Yunus's "Three Zero" theory-Zero Poverty, Zero Unemployment, and Zero Carbon Emission-as a modern utopian vision, postulating that it is primarily a sophisticated propaganda mechanism designed to re-legitimise and expand the Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) microfinance business model. The study argues that the concept lacks originality, serving instead as a semantic repackaging of long-standing global objectives, particularly the UN's Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) adopted in 2015. Historically, Zero Poverty has been the core mandate of postwar development; Zero Unemployment was a core policy in state-controlled economies like the Soviet Union; and Zero Carbon initiatives date back to the 1970s EU policies and environmental movements. The true novelty, this paper contends, lies not in the goal itself but in how the goal is commodified to attract international goodwill and funding. Drawing on empirical and journalistic reports from the microcredit epicentre, Bangladesh, the research exposes the operational paradox: the microcredit mechanism, intended to achieve the 'Zero Unemployment' and 'Zero Poverty' goals, often devolves into a debt trap. This tragic reality is evidenced by multiple documented cases linking aggressive debt collection and chronic over-indebtedness to tragic incidents of suicide among vulnerable borrowers. The analysis concludes that the 'Three Zero' framework is fundamentally an ethical paradox, functioning as a new and profitable Business Model for NGOs under the veneer of humanitarian economics.

AI.tldr: 该研究批判性分析了穆罕默德·尤努斯的'三零'理论（零贫困、零失业、零碳排放），认为其本质上是为重新合法化并扩展NGO小额信贷业务模式的宣传机制，而非原创性概念。
AI.research_question: '三零'理论是否真的具有原创性，还是仅仅是对现有全球目标的语义重新包装？该理论在实践中是否真正实现了其宣称的人道主义目标？
AI.motivation: 批判性地检验'三零'理论作为现代乌托邦愿景的真实本质，揭示其作为NGO小额信贷业务模式再合法化工具的功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于批判性发展理论和人道主义经济学分析框架，探讨乌托邦愿景与商业利益之间的张力。
AI.method: 采用实证和新闻报告分析，特别关注孟加拉国这一小额信贷发源地的实际案例。
AI.findings: '三零'理论缺乏原创性，是对联合国可持续发展目标等现有目标的重新包装；小额信贷机制在实践中往往演变为债务陷阱，与自杀等悲剧事件相关；该框架本质上是伦理悖论，在表面的人道主义经济学下为NGO创造新的盈利商业模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了乌托邦发展愿景如何被商品化以获取国际善意和资金；提出了'伦理悖论'概念来分析表面人道主义与实际商业利益之间的矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和国际发展机构提供了对'三零'理论批判性视角；揭示了小额信贷模式在实践中的潜在危害，呼吁更负责任的发展干预措施。

title: Virtual Asset Laundering and Cryptocurrency Blending and Mixing Services
affiliations: University of East London

detail.title: Virtual Asset Laundering and Cryptocurrency Blending and Mixing Services
detail.abstract:
This article reviews the Financial Action Task Force’s (FATF) efforts to extend anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CTF) standards to virtual assets. At a May 2019 consultation, industry participants and regulators debated Paragraph 7(b) of the Interpretive Note to Recommendation 15, which would require virtual asset service providers (VASPs) to collect and transmit originator and beneficiary information. While broadly supportive of regulation, industry stakeholders cautioned against applying legacy banking rules to peer-to-peer blockchain systems and stressed the need for RegTech solutions to balance transparency with confidentiality.

The article highlights a critical regulatory gap: cryptocurrency blending and mixing services. These tools obscure blockchain transaction trails, functioning as digital equivalents of money laundering layering, and are widely accessible online and on the dark web. Unlike privacy coins, which some jurisdictions have restricted, mixers remain largely unregulated and absent from FATF’s framework.

Without directly addressing mixers, global standards risk leaving significant vulnerabilities in AML/CTF oversight. Progress on Recommendation 15 is notable, but its effectiveness will depend on tackling anonymity-enhancing services alongside broader virtual asset regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了FATF将反洗钱和反恐融资标准扩展到虚拟资产的努力，重点关注加密货币混合服务的监管漏洞，指出需要平衡透明度与保密性的监管科技解决方案。
AI.research_question: FATF如何将AML/CTF标准扩展到虚拟资产？加密货币混合服务存在哪些监管漏洞？
AI.motivation: 随着虚拟资产的普及，需要建立有效的监管框架来防止洗钱和恐怖融资，但现有标准未能充分覆盖加密货币混合服务等匿名化工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于反洗钱和反恐融资理论框架，结合区块链技术和虚拟资产监管理论。
AI.method: 文献综述和2019年5月FATF咨询会议的分析，评估行业参与者和监管机构的讨论。
AI.findings: 行业支持监管但反对简单套用传统银行规则；加密货币混合服务作为数字洗钱分层工具，目前缺乏监管；FATF框架存在显著漏洞。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了虚拟资产监管理论，识别了加密货币混合服务的监管空白，提出了平衡透明度与保密性的监管框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供针对虚拟资产服务提供商的监管建议，强调需要专门针对匿名化服务的监管措施。

title: From Losses to Buffer - Calibrating the Positive Neutral CCyB Rate in the Euro Area
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), Bank of England, European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: From Losses to Buffer - Calibrating the Positive Neutral CCyB Rate in the Euro Area
detail.abstract: We study the impact of cyclical systemic risks on banks’ profitability in the euro area using a panel quantile regression model to inform the calibration of the Countercyclical Capital Buffer (CCyB). Compared to previous studies, we control for unobserved bank-specific characteristics and year-fixed effects, finding less heterogeneity in the estimated effects across the conditional distribution of banks’ returns on assets. We propose a simple and intuitive framework to calibrate the CCyB through the cycle, including the “positive neutral” rate. The model suggests a target positive neutral rate for the euro area between 1.1% and 1.8%. The calibrated CCyB rates align with the evolution of domestic cyclical systemic risks. Moreover, adopting a positive neutral CCyB allows an earlier and more gradual buffer build-up without increasing requirements at the cycle’s peak and would have implied positive CCyB rates in most euro area countries at the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用面板分位数回归模型分析欧元区周期性系统性风险对银行盈利能力的影响，为逆周期资本缓冲（CCyB）的校准提供依据。研究发现CCyB的正向中性利率目标在1.1%-1.8%之间，采用正向中性CCyB可在不增加周期峰值要求的情况下更早、更渐进地建立缓冲。
AI.research_question: 周期性系统性风险如何影响欧元区银行的盈利能力？如何基于这些影响校准逆周期资本缓冲（CCyB）？
AI.motivation: 为逆周期资本缓冲提供更精确的校准框架，改进现有研究方法，控制银行特定特征和年份固定效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、银行盈利能力理论、逆周期资本缓冲理论
AI.method: 面板分位数回归模型，控制未观察到的银行特定特征和年份固定效应
AI.findings: 1) 在控制银行特定特征后，银行资产回报率条件分布中的异质性较小；2) 欧元区CCyB正向中性利率目标为1.1%-1.8%；3) 正向中性CCyB可实现更早、更渐进的缓冲建立
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 改进了CCyB校准的理论框架；2) 提出了正向中性利率概念；3) 深化了对系统性风险与银行盈利能力关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构提供实用的CCyB校准工具；2) 有助于更有效地管理金融周期；3) 在COVID-19疫情初期可提供更好的缓冲保护

title: At Arm's Length: Using Fiduciary Management to Prevent and Resolve Conflicts of Interest
affiliations: Anti-Corruption Center, HSE University and Anti-Corruption Center, HSE University

detail.title: At Arm's Length: Using Fiduciary Management to Prevent and Resolve Conflicts of Interest
detail.abstract: One possible way to resolve certain types of conflicts of interest is to put a public official's assets under fiduciary management and curtail the owner's discretion over them. Among mechanisms of this kind, the most well-known are probably blind trusts. They have been widely used in the United Kingdom and the United States, as well as in Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, and have been tested in several other countries, including those in Eastern Europe and Latin America. However, the question of how effective they are in preventing corruption remains open. This paper thoroughly examines potential approaches to using fiduciary management to mitigate conflicts of interest. It discusses questions that are important to address when developing relevant mechanisms at the national level, considers the advantages and disadvantages of solutions applied by different countries, and draws general conclusions about the workability of this anti-corruption tool, including in highly corrupt environments.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了利用信托管理解决利益冲突的有效性，重点分析了盲信托在反腐败中的实际效果，并比较了不同国家的实践经验。

title: Pricing the Common Ground Taxonomy: Evidence from Green Bonds *
affiliations: Shanghai Dianji University, Central University of Finance and Economics and The University of Western Australia - UWA Business School

detail.title: Pricing the Common Ground Taxonomy: Evidence from Green Bonds *
detail.abstract: Common Ground Taxonomy (CGT) identify and map the commonalities between EU's Sustainable Finance Taxonomy and China's Green Bond Endorsed Project Catalogue. We document that the yield spreads of CGT-labelled bonds are about 5.89 basis points lower than that of comparable non-CGT-labelled green bonds in China. The CGT premium is more pronounced when the green bonds are labelled at issuance. Further analyses show that the impact of CGT labelling on bond pricing is more pronounced when the issuers have lower ESG rating and more foreign institutional investors. In addition, we find that the subscription in the primary and the liquidity in the secondary bond are higher for CGT-labelled bond comparing with other green bonds.

AI.tldr: 本研究识别并映射了欧盟可持续金融分类标准与中国绿色债券支持项目目录之间的共同点，构建了共同基础分类标准(CGT)。研究发现，在中国，CGT标签债券的收益率利差比可比非CGT标签绿色债券低约5.89个基点。CGT溢价在债券发行时贴标的情况下更为显著。
AI.research_question: 共同基础分类标准(CGT)标签如何影响中国绿色债券的定价、流动性和投资者行为？
AI.motivation: 随着全球绿色金融标准的多样化，理解不同标准之间的共同点及其对市场的影响具有重要意义。欧盟和中国作为全球两大绿色金融市场，其标准协调对促进跨境绿色投资至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论、信号理论和投资者偏好理论，研究绿色标准协调对债券市场的影响机制。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，通过比较CGT标签债券与非CGT标签绿色债券的收益率利差、一级市场认购情况和二级市场流动性。
AI.findings: 1) CGT标签债券收益率利差低5.89个基点；2) 发行时贴标效果更显著；3) 对ESG评级较低发行人和外资机构投资者较多的债券影响更大；4) CGT标签债券在一级市场认购和二级市场流动性方面表现更好。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了绿色金融标准协调的理论框架，揭示了标准互认在降低信息不对称和增强市场信心方面的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供标准协调的实际效果证据，为投资者识别高质量绿色债券提供参考，促进中欧绿色金融市场的互联互通。

affiliations: , Florida State University and University of South Florida - Muma College of Business

detail.title: A Text-Based Measure of Corporate Risk Management
detail.abstract: In this study, we develop and validate a text-based measure of corporate risk management. Despite the growing importance of risk management over time, academic studies typically focus on one aspect of a firm's risk management program, such as hedging or insurance purchases. Using text from analyst reports, we apply machine learning techniques to develop a firm-specific, time-varying measure of corporate risk management. In addition to statistical validation, we find that our measure is correlated with key firm characteristics, including size and leverage, and is associated with reduced future accounting-and market-based risk as well as enhanced firm value. Importantly, by comparing our measure to Chief Risk Officer (CRO) appointments and decomposing their informational overlap, we find that the unique information captured by our text-based measure, unlike that tied to CRO appointments, is significantly related to risk reduction and value enhancement. These results highlight the importance of a deeply embedded risk management culture, suggesting that the full benefits of effective risk management practices are best understood when considering both organizational structures and the underlying cultural drivers communicated to external stakeholders.

title: Fiscal Announcements and Households’ Beliefs: Evidence from the Euro Area

detail.title: Fiscal Announcements and Households’ Beliefs: Evidence from the Euro Area

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper studies the effects of fiscal policy announcements on household expectations. We document announcements of price-related expansionary fiscal measures in response to the cost-of-living crisis in the four largest euro area economies and exploit the exogenous timing of fiscal actions relative to household survey participation to estimate their causal effects. Following fiscal announcements, households revise their beliefs: inflation perceptions rise, and unemployment perceptions fall. The latter effect persists into short-run unemployment expectations, while inflation expectations remain unchanged and suggest households perceived inflationary pressures as temporary. These results suggest a significant signaling channel of fiscal policy, as fiscal announcements reveal information about the underlying economic conditions and the government’s commitment to stabilization. We rationalize these findings through a general equilibrium New Keynesian model extended with information frictions and an inflation-stabilizing role for fiscal policy. The model isolates the informational content of fiscal policy and shows that belief revisions are consistent with demand-driven dynamics.

title: Paradigm Reconstruction: From US-EU Tax Battles to the Nonlinear Future of Tech Giants' Quasi-Nationalization
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Paradigm Reconstruction: From US-EU Tax Battles to the Nonlinear Future of Tech Giants' Quasi-Nationalization
detail.abstract: Traditional linear thinking in international political economy struggles to explain the structural contradictions behind the US-EU digital tax dispute. Building on Thomas Kuhn's theory of "paradigm shifts," this paper argues that the global political economy is undergoing an involuntary transformation of its deep structure. The old paradigm of liberal internationalism-centered on nation-states and free markets-is increasingly ineffective in the face of borderless digital economies, the supra-national power of technology giants, and the mounting debt burdens of major economies. Great-power rivalry is no longer about "profit allocation" but rather about control over "technological sovereignty" and the "institutional future." By analyzing the TikTok controversy, former U.S. President Donald Trump's proposal for a partial government stake in Intel, and the digital governance practices of India and Brazil, the paper projects three potential forms of "quasi-nationalization" of technology giants: digital commons, franchised strategic developers, and algorithmic utilities. It concludes that the global order is shifting toward a new capitalist paradigm where security logic dominates and the boundary between public and private spheres becomes increasingly blurred, leading to a nonlinear future characterized by plural institutional competition.

AI.tldr: 本文基于库恩的范式转移理论，认为全球政治经济正经历深层结构的非自愿转型。传统自由国际主义范式在应对无边界数字经济、科技巨头的超国家权力和主要经济体债务负担时日益失效。大国竞争从利润分配转向技术主权和制度未来的控制，可能催生科技巨头的准国有化形式。
AI.research_question: 全球政治经济如何从传统自由国际主义范式向新的资本主义范式转型？
AI.motivation: 传统线性思维难以解释美欧数字税争端背后的结构性矛盾，需要新的理论框架来理解全球政治经济的深层变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 托马斯·库恩的范式转移理论，用于分析全球政治经济从自由国际主义向新资本主义范式的转型。
AI.method: 通过分析TikTok争议、特朗普对英特尔的政府持股提议、印度和巴西的数字治理实践等案例研究。
AI.findings: 大国竞争焦点从利润分配转向技术主权和制度未来控制；科技巨头可能出现三种准国有化形式：数字公地、特许战略开发商和算法公用事业。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出全球政治经济正在经历范式转移的新理论框架，挑战传统线性思维。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解数字时代大国竞争本质和科技治理提供实践指导，预测未来可能的制度竞争格局。

title: Small Talks and the Fed Predictability

detail.title: Small Talks and the Fed Predictability
detail.abstract: I present empirical evidence that market participants and economic forecasters fail to extract relevant information from policymakers' communications. Using textual analysis, I measure the content of FOMC members' speeches since the 1960s. Despite having little immediate market impact, communications from non-Chair members significantly predict interest rate forecast errors and excess bond returns in the United States. In contrast, communications from Chairs and Vice-Chairs move markets on impact but contain no predictive information beyond what is already reflected in private-sector expectations. To explain this puzzle, I develop a rational inattention model where policymakers set interest rates based on their time-varying views. Firms allocate attention across central bank communications to infer the policy rule and forecast future monetary decisions. In equilibrium, rational firms optimally specialize-focusing all attention on Chair communications-thereby leaving valuable information embedded in non-Chair speeches underexploited.

AI.tldr: 研究发现市场参与者未能充分提取美联储非主席成员演讲中的预测信息，这些信息能显著预测利率预测误差和债券超额收益，而主席的发言虽能立即影响市场但缺乏额外预测价值。
AI.research_question: 市场参与者是否能够充分提取美联储官员沟通中的相关信息？
AI.motivation: 理解市场参与者如何从央行沟通中提取信息，以及为何某些有价值的信息被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性疏忽模型，企业分配注意力以推断政策规则和预测未来货币政策。
AI.method: 文本分析测量FOMC成员自1960年代以来的演讲内容，结合实证分析市场反应和预测能力。
AI.findings: 非主席成员的沟通虽无即时市场影响，但能显著预测利率预测误差和超额债券收益；主席沟通有即时市场影响但无额外预测价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了理性疏忽模型解释企业为何最优地专注于主席沟通，导致非主席演讲中的有价值信息未被充分利用。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了市场信息提取的局限性，为投资者和政策制定者提供了关于央行沟通有效性的重要见解。

title: In a Hurry to Graduate? The Effects of Compressed Schooling on Degree Completion

detail.title: In a Hurry to Graduate? The Effects of Compressed Schooling on Degree Completion

contentType.other: Submitted to Education Finance and Policy on 07/28/25 (Submission # 2025098). Currently under review.

detail.abstract: Using data from the German Socioeconomic Panel, this paper exploits a federal education reform that compressed instructional time to study how more intense education influenced degree completion. Staggered difference-indifferences estimates indicate that compressing instruction increased late graduation by 19.3 percentage points but actually increased the share of students who finally graduated by 5.7 percentage points. This may reflect a normalization of late graduation with the reform and so an increased willingness to do so. As a consequence, the average time spent to graduate decreased even as the graduation rate increased.
